title: Camera Assembly
subtitle: Nine floating parts. One imaginary instant camera.
description: Explore an original saffron-and-cream instant camera in real-time 3D. Scrub a five-stage assembly, inspect nine component groups, orbit four view presets, and reveal a locally drawn print. This is a design-fiction motion study, not an engineering model or repair guide.
instruction: Play or scrub the assembly. Drag to orbit; choose a part to pause, separate, and highlight it.
